about_the_game:
Dark and Darker – New Season Starting!

Dark and Darker Early Access Season 6 has begun!
Get the Season Pack now to enjoy special benefits for the whole season – plus a torch cosmetic that’s yours forever.

EA#6 Seasonal Pack Contents:

  • Permanent Collection Item

    • Torch Skin: Gaze of the Abyss (permanent!)

  • Seasonal Limited Item

    • Seasonal Shared Stash +1

    • Seasonal Character Slot +1

    • Seasonal Marketplace Listing Slots +10

    • Gold Coin Bag x5 (Non-tradable)

    • Consumables

      • Bandage(3) x12

      • Potion of Healing(3) x12

      • Potion of Protection(3) x12

      • Magic Protection Potion(3) x12

      • Lockpick(3) x12

  • Important

    • Seasonal Pack are non-refundable, and Seasonal Limited Items expire when the next season starts.

    • Sales Period:  ~ 26/Jun./2025, 23:59:59 (UTC+0)

    • Available Through : ~ 10/Jul./2025, 23:59:59 (UTC+0)

    • Get yours early to max out the benefits!
